frontendRequestCalls.call: fetch(`/__preview${path}`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": file.type }, body: file, })

fetcher(base + path, { method, credentials: "include", signal: controller.signal, headers: { ...(body === undefined || body instanceof FormData ? {} : { "Content-Type": "application/json" }), ...(["GET", "HEAD"].includes(method) ? {} : { "X-VMS-Request": "browser" }), ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}), ...(csrf ? { "X-CSRF-Token": csrf } : {}), }, body: body === undefined ? undefined : body instanceof FormData ? body : JSON.stringify(body), })
request( `/staff/employees?${new URLSearchParams({ q: filter.q, page: String(filter.page), pageSize: String(filter.pageSize) })}`, { authenticated: true, signal }, )
request(`/staff/employees${id ? "/" + encodeURIComponent(id) : ""}`, { body, method: id ? "PATCH" : "POST", authenticated: true, })
request(`/staff/roles/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}`, { body: { permissions, version: record.version }, method: "PATCH", authenticated: true, })
request( development ? `/staff/bookings?role=${encodeURIComponent(role)}` : "/staff/bookings", { body: { ...input, idempotencyKey: key }, authenticated: true }, )

request( development && action === "cancel" ? `/staff/bookings/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/cancel?role=${encodeURIComponent(role)}` : staff(`/bookings/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${endpoint}`, role), { body: requestBody, authenticated: true, }, )
request(staff("/resolve", role), { body: { credential }, authenticated: true })
request(publicPath("/lookup"), { body: { code: code.trim(), email: email.trim() } })
request(publicPath(`/bookings/${encodeURIComponent(booking.id)}/admission`), { body: { code: booking.code, email: booking.email, version: booking.version }, signal, })
request("/staff/password", { body: { currentPassword, newPassword }, authenticated: true, })
request("/staff/session/renew", { body: {}, authenticated: true, signal: controller.signal, })
request("/staff/session/role", { body: { role: next }, authenticated: true, })

sourceCorrections.finding: 202611180007_create_vms_pegawai.sql defines jabatan/kedeputian/direktorat/nomor_hp/nip on vms.pegawai; no separate profile migration is needed.

User requirement 2026-11-15: one current official per employee, with automatic organizational affiliation. 202611180002_create_vms_kedeputian.sql and 202611180003_create_vms_direktorat.sql create the Kedeputian-to-Direktorat reference hierarchy with verified unit names only, 202611180004_create_vms_jabatan.sql links Jabatan to one unit, and 202611180009_create_vms_pegawai_pejabat.sql enforces one active assignment per employee. See EMPLOYEE-ORGANIZATION.md.
